items.headline: Zelenskyy warns of major Russian attack as Trump urges restraint
items.summary: Trump urged Putin to 'pull back' after Russian strikes hit Kharkiv and energy sites in the Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk regions.

items.headline: Kurds protest as Baghdad moves to take over oilfields
items.summary: Protesters in Erbil rallied against the Iraqi prime minister's order; Baghdad denied reports that troops were moving towards the Kurdish region.

items.headline: DR Congo Ebola cases pass 12,000
items.summary: Fighting in the east of the country is disrupting the response to the outbreak.

items.headline: FTSE 100 jumps 1.75% as banks and miners rally
items.summary: The index closed at 10,609.30 on Thursday, recovering from recent losses while US markets were shut for Thanksgiving.

items.headline: Imperial Brands rises on takeover interest; Babcock wins defence deal
items.summary: The two were among the strongest FTSE 100 performers on Thursday.

items.headline: European shares rally, with the DAX up 2%
items.summary: Germany's DAX closed up 2.08% and the Euro Stoxx 50 up 2.04% on Thursday.

items.headline: Anthropic used Claude to rebuild its API, cutting CPU use 70%
items.summary: The API that routes every Claude conversation was rewritten from Python to Rust with no downtime during the switch.

items.headline: US regulator clears SpaceX for up to 1 million AI satellites
items.summary: The FCC authorised the satellites, which carry AI chips, under SpaceX's Starmind plan for data centres in orbit.

items.headline: OpenAI tests Private Inference for business customers
items.summary: The feature lets companies run prompts through OpenAI's models without OpenAI itself being able to read them.
